newsitem.title: LATVIA: HANSA INVESTMENT EYES LATVIA FUND.
newsitem.headline: HANSA INVESTMENT EYES LATVIA FUND.

text.p: Estonia's Hansa Investments said on Thursday that it plans to set up an asset management fund in Latvia as soon as the necessary legislation is in place.
"We are looking at the Latvian market at the moment and gathering information," Aadu Oja, managing director of Hansa Investment's asset management division, told Reuters.
"Changes are needed first in the legislation regarding investment funds...when the the changes are made, we will be ready," he said.
Hansa Investments, which previously focussed on corporate finance, recently set up an asset management fund in Estonia.
Asset management has been an industry of rapid growth in Estonia, where the market capitlisation of mutual funds has risen to 1.3 billion kroons from 300 million kroons over the past year, Oja said.
